fire_authority: MAIN only. ddm_fx2 fired nothing and spent nothing.
mechanism: The ddm_fx1 fixed-point log-odds mixer, with (a) its causal template widened from left+up to four neighbours -- measured causal against the real group_index.u8, whose rule is exactly (x&63)+2*(y&63) -- and (b) a NEW local-homogeneity feature: the number of DISTINCT decoded classes among those neighbours, which detects a boundary of the already-decoded partition rather than agreement with the prediction. Both are free receiver code reading only already-decoded symbols: ZERO transmitted bytes, rule 118 clean. No log/exp/pow on the decision path; AST-gated.
distortion_claim: d_seg and d_pose are UNCHANGED BY CONSTRUCTION: only the probability law moves, so the decoded token field is bit-identical and the render cannot change. This is the same claim ddm_fx1 PROVED on its own candidate (decoded field 9ba2e52b..., render e5539653..., both bit-identical to base across two independent decodes).
